dct_title_s: Shaw Quadrangle, Minnesota - St. Louis County, 1953: 7.5 Minute Series (Topographic) Map
dct_description_sm: Shaw quadrangle topographic map (N4700-W9215.5/7.5) featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in pencil and red ink regarding logging railroad lines and camps in the Cloquet Valley State Forest area. The hand written notations include information on the following: logging camps noted with 'C'.
